reviews.summary: The patch introduces a new private-node zonelist to simplify page allocation for nodes without N_MEMORY_COMMON. It restricts allocations to local zones within the node, reducing complexity and improving performance.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series introduces a new private-node zonelist to the Linux kernel's memory management system. The private-node zonelist is designed for nodes that do not have N_MEMORY_COMMON, and it restricts allocations to only local zones within the node. This approach aims to simplify the page allocator by reducing complexity and improving performance.
